biomarkers.name: HER2 (ERBB2)
biomarkers.clinical_use: HER2+ (IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified): trastuzumab + chemo first-line (ToGA). Pembrolizumab + trastuzumab + chemo (KEYNOTE-811, gastric/GEJ extrapolation to HER2+ metastatic esophageal/GEJ adenocarcinoma in guidelines). T-DXd in later lines

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (CPS)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Nivolumab + chemo first-line in advanced HER2-negative esophageal/GEJ adenocarcinoma with greatest benefit at higher CPS (CheckMate 649/648 era practice); pembrolizumab + trastuzumab + chemo in HER2+ disease; adjuvant nivolumab after neoadjuvant chemoradiation and R0 resection with residual pathologic disease (CheckMate 577)

biomarkers.name: MSI / dMMR
biomarkers.clinical_use: Pembrolizumab or dostarlimab in advanced MSI-H/dMMR disease; dMMR is uncommon in esophageal adenocarcinoma. 'May skip surgery' is not established standard for esophageal adenocarcinoma, and KEYNOTE-585 does not support that claim

biomarkers.name: CLDN18.2 (Claudin 18.2)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Zolbetuximab + chemo first-line for CLDN18.2-positive, HER2-negative advanced gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma (SPOTLIGHT, GLOW); evidence is primarily gastric/GEJ rather than distal esophageal adenocarcinoma

biomarkers.name: FGFR2 amplification / mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: FGFR2b-targeted bemarituzumab remains investigational/in trials; no established approved FGFR-directed standard specifically for esophageal adenocarcinoma

biomarkers.name: EBV
biomarkers.prevalence: Essentially absent or extremely rare in esophageal adenocarcinoma (far more relevant in gastric carcinoma)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Not a routine biomarker in esophageal adenocarcinoma; if detected, may suggest gastric-type biology rather than typical Barrett-associated EAC

biomarkers.name: TP53, KRAS, SMAD4
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common genomic alterations with mainly prognostic/biologic significance; no standard targeted therapy for most KRAS-altered EAC

biomarkers.name: MET amplification
biomarkers.clinical_use: Potential therapeutic target in selected advanced cases/trials; not a routine standard biomarker in localized disease

biomarkers.name: EGFR amplification
biomarkers.clinical_use: Recurrent CIN-type driver amplification; no established routine anti-EGFR standard specifically for EAC, but may support trial enrollment

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Glandular / tubular architecture arising from Barrett's metaplasia; often mucin-producing
variants: signet-ring cell (rare in esophagus, more in stomach)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Variable; MSI-H subsets are highly inflamed; EBV-associated disease is essentially not a meaningful esophageal adenocarcinoma subset; conventional Barrett-derived tumours are often less inflamed than MSI-H tumors
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Desmoplastic; often arises in background of Barrett's oesophagus with intestinal metaplasia

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Metaplastic intestinalized columnar epithelium in Barrett's esophagus
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm — foregut derivative (through metaplastic transformation of native squamous-lined distal esophagus)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Intestinal-type glandular differentiation (often CDX2 positive; CK7/CK20 variable) reflecting Barrett's origin; distinct from native squamous
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Chronic GERD drives squamous → columnar metaplasia/Barrett's → dysplasia → invasive adenocarcinoma — a striking lineage-switching cascade over years to decades
